name: Burton
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Burton, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Burton, Ohio for 2026: Christmas Express train rides, Santa at the Log Cabin, the Christmas Light Parade and The Nativity Story at Century Village Museum.
lede: Burton turns its village square into A Burton Country Christmas, with a tree lighting and light parade, Christmas Express train rides, Santa at the Log Cabin and a live Nativity at Century Village Museum.
celebrates: The Burton Chamber of Commerce presents A Burton Country Christmas with a tree lighting at the gazebo on Burton Square, a Christmas Light Parade, Christmas Express train rides and Santa at the Burton Log Cabin. Century Village Museum, run by the Geauga County Historical Society, adds Breakfast with Santa on November 28 and The Nativity Story on December 11 to 13 in the historic Auburn Church.
lastyear: We did not find a 2025 Burton schedule on the chamber's site, so the 2026 dates here come from the chamber's A Burton Country Christmas page and events calendar, plus Century Village Museum's own event pages.
facts: The chamber's calendar says the Christmas Light Parade has more than 40 festive entries decorated and illuminated with holiday cheer, and that Parade Grand Marshal is Vic Gideon of WOIO channel 19. The Ugly Sweater 5K, 1 Mile Penguin Waddle and Little Elf Dash on December 12 benefits the Burton Chamber Country Christmas Celebration.
trains: The Christmas Express is Burton's own holiday train ride, running around the square from the Burton Log Cabin on Friday, November 27 from 3 pm to 8 pm and Saturday, November 28 from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the chamber. Lake Metroparks Farmpark in Kirtland has a North Pole Train Display in its Holiday Ice & Lights Festival. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs its North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in Independence from November 13 to December 22, 2026, with 5:00 pm and 7:55 pm departures and tickets listed at $60 to $110 per person, according to the railroad.
train_links: The railroad that runs the North Pole Adventure Christmas train from Rockside Station in Independence.
traditions: More than 40 decorated and illuminated entries after the 6 pm tree lighting on Burton Square.
A holiday train ride around the square from the Log Cabin.
Santa visits at the cabin on the square, with reservations recommended.
A pancake breakfast with the museum's own maple syrup at Century Village Museum.
A live performance in the historic Auburn Church, $10 per person.
kidfact: Burton is known for maple syrup, and the pancake breakfast with Santa at Century Village Museum is made with the museum's own syrup from its farm.
faq: What is the best Christmas event for kids in Burton?
A Burton Country Christmas weekend, November 27 and 28, with the tree lighting and Christmas Light Parade, Christmas Express train rides, Santa at the Log Cabin and Breakfast with Santa.
Are there train rides in Burton?
The Christmas Express runs around the square from the Log Cabin on November 27 from 3 pm to 8 pm and November 28 from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the Burton Chamber of Commerce.
How much is The Nativity Story?
$10 per person, with performances December 11 to 13 at Century Village Museum's Historic Auburn Church.
When is Santa at the Log Cabin?
Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28, then Saturdays and Sundays through December 20. The chamber recommends reservations at 440-834-4204.

folded.note: Santa Around Town listing is the 2024 event; no 2026 listing found.
